findings.summary: Days above 99 were silently truncated: the unit destructured the first two characters, so a 122-day countdown rendered as '12'. Reachable with the repo's own .env.example default and invisible to the E2E suite, whose clock instants all sit under 24h from target. Fixed by capping at 99 in lib/prelaunch/display.ts (8 regression tests) and rendering one box per character so a broken guarantee shows as a visible extra box instead of vanishing.

The T-0 unlock guard was scoped to a single mount, so a viewer whose clock ran ahead of the server's would redirect, get bounced back by the proxy, remount, and fire again — a continuous / <-> /prelaunch flicker for the whole skew window. Fixed with a sessionStorage-backed 30s throttle that self-heals rather than stranding the viewer at 00:00:00.
The architecture doc asserted the project has no middleware, which proxy.ts made false. Reconciled in this delivery along with the F010 registration, the promoted feature spec and ADR-002.

aria-label on the unit container alongside readable child text may double-announce in some screen readers. The digit background layer is already aria-hidden. Left as-is rather than churn accessibility semantics with no screen-reader test to verify against.

The 'Digital Numbers' font file has not been supplied, so digits render in a monospace fallback and each page load emits one 404 for /fonts/digital-numbers.woff2. @font-face is wired so supplying the file is a zero-code-change swap. Tracked as an open question with the design owner.

Sub-1512px responsive behaviour is derived, not designed — the MoMorph frame exists only at 1512 wide. Floors hold at 45% of frame size below ~680px, preserving the design's 2:1 digit-to-label ratio and fitting a 320px viewport. Flagged to the design owner rather than presented as specified.
